scripts.build:command: bunx rimraf dist && bunx vite build -c vite.config.node.ts && bunx vite build -c vite.config.define.ts && bunx vite build -c vite.config.billing.ts && bunx vite build -c vite.config.front-component.ts && bunx vite build -c vite.config.logic-function.ts && bunx vite build -c vite.config.utils.ts && bunx vite build -c vite.config.browser.ts && tsgo -p tsconfig.lib.json --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --noEmit false --outDir dist --rootDir src && bunx tsc-alias -p tsconfig.lib.json --outDir dist && bunx rimraf 'dist/sdk' 'dist/define/**/*.d.ts' 'dist/define/**/*.d.ts.map' 'dist/billing/**/*.d.ts' 'dist/billing/**/*.d.ts.map' 'dist/front-component/**/*.d.ts' 'dist/front-component/**/*.d.ts.map' 'dist/logic-function/**/*.d.ts' 'dist/logic-function/**/*.d.ts.map' 'dist/utils/**/*.d.ts' 'dist/utils/**/*.d.ts.map' && bunx rollup -c rollup.config.sdk-dts.mjs
scripts.dev:command: bunx vite-plus run twenty-sdk#build && bunx concurrently "bunx vite build -c vite.config.node.ts --watch" "bunx vite build -c vite.config.define.ts --watch" "bunx vite build -c vite.config.billing.ts --watch" "bunx vite build -c vite.config.front-component.ts --watch" "bunx vite build -c vite.config.logic-function.ts --watch" "bunx vite build -c vite.config.utils.ts --watch" "bunx vite build -c vite.config.browser.ts --watch"
scripts.set-local-version: bun -e 'const fs = require("fs"); const version = process.argv[1]; if (!version) throw new Error("releaseVersion required"); const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("package.json", "utf8")); pkg.version = version; fs.writeFileSync("package.json", JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + "\n");'
scripts.lint:command: bunx oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json . && (bunx oxfmt --check . || (echo 'ERROR: oxfmt formatting check failed! Fix with: bun run lint:fix:command' && false))
scripts.test:e2e:command: bunx wait-on http://localhost:3000/healthz --timeout 600000 --interval 1000 --log && NODE_ENV=test bunx vitest run --config ./vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.build:sdk:command: bunx vite build -c vite.config.define.ts && bunx vite build -c vite.config.billing.ts && bunx vite build -c vite.config.front-component.ts && bunx vite build -c vite.config.logic-function.ts && bunx vite build -c vite.config.utils.ts && bunx rollup -c rollup.config.sdk-dts.mjs
